name: Sump Scythe Horror
senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 30 ft.; Passive Perception 15

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The scythe horror makes two attacks, using Spitting Maw or Scythe Limb in any combination.

Actions.name: Spitting Maw
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 10 ft. 18 (4d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) Acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16). If the target already has the Grappled condition, the target takes an extra 16 (3d10) Acid damage. This effect can be applied only once per turn.

riderNeeds.text: If the target already has the Grappled condition, the target takes an extra 16 (3d10) Acid damage. This effect can be applied only once per turn.

Actions.name: Scythe Limb
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. 18 (4d6 + 4) Slashing damage.
Actions.flavor: The free arms sweep down in long carving strokes, peeling the pinned prey apart.

Bonus Actions.name: Swallow
Bonus Actions.text: The scythe horror swallows one Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. While swallowed, the target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the scythe horror, and takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the scythe horror's turns. The scythe horror can have only one creature swallowed at a time. If the scythe horror takes 25 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the scythe horror must regurgitate the target at the end of that turn, and the target exits Prone in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of the scythe horror. If the scythe horror dies, a swallowed creature exits the body Prone by using 10 feet of movement.

Traits.name: Pinning Arms
Traits.text: While the scythe horror has a creature Grappled with its Spitting Maw, the scythe horror can pin that creature with two of its arms; the Grappled creature cannot move farther than the scythe horror's reach allows unless it first escapes the grapple.
Traits.clause: It fights by pinning prey with two arms

Traits.name: Caustic Crust
Traits.text: At the end of each of the scythe horror's turns, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the scythe horror takes 7 (2d6) Acid damage.

lore: A calcified insect born in the sump of a poison-laced underground river, it patrols its hatching grounds with a predator's patience for any meat large enough to feed a clutch.
